description: Patient-facing health app — medical records, prescriptions, appointments, consultations, and health tracking. Healthcare industry only.

three_js.description: Very slow drifting soft circular particles. Clinical calm. No sharp geometry. Light background with gentle movement. Never dark or aggressive.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: Patient has many Appointments with Doctors
MedicalRecord contains LabResults and health history
Appointment can be in-person or virtual Consultation
HealthMetric belongs to Patient — tracked over time
Notification belongs to Patient — reminders, results, updates

layout.notes: Light background always — clinical trust. Never dark mode by default. Accessibility first — minimum 16px body, high contrast on all medical information.

avoid: Never use dark mode as the default — healthcare requires high contrast light UI for readability
Never use red for branding or decorative elements — red means urgency or danger in this context
Never truncate medical information — always show full prescription name, dosage, and instructions
Never use informal language in medical contexts — always precise and clinical
Never show another patient's data — role separation is absolute
Never allow appointment booking without confirming insurance coverage where applicable
Never hide cancellation policy — always shown before booking confirmed
Never use gamification elements (streaks, badges, points) for medication adherence — trivialises compliance
enforce: Medication instructions always shown in full — never truncated
Doctor credentials always verified badge visible
Appointment status always colour-coded: confirmed green, pending amber, cancelled grey
Emergency contact and crisis resources always one tap away from profile
All health data changes logged with timestamp — audit trail
HIPAA compliance badge visible on any messaging or data sharing screen
Prescription expiry date always shown — amber warning 7 days before expiry
Lab results always shown with reference range — never just the value

empty_states.ui: Welcome card with profile completion prompt. 'Complete your health profile' progress bar. Upcoming appointments section shows 'Book your first appointment' CTA.
Document illustration. Message: 'Your medical records will appear here'. Sub: 'Records are added after your appointments'. No empty table.
Pill bottle illustration. Message: 'No active prescriptions'. Sub: 'Prescriptions from your doctor will appear here'. Never show empty rows.

loading_states.ui: Health summary card skeleton. Upcoming appointment card skeleton. Active prescription skeleton pills row. All shimmer simultaneously.
Record list skeleton — date left, title centre, type badge right. 5 rows shimmer. Category tabs visible and interactive during load.
Calendar loads from cache immediately. Doctor availability skeleton chips in time slot grid. Show 'Loading availability...' below calendar.

error_flows.ui: Full screen: 'That slot was just booked'. Next available slots shown immediately — no extra tap. Pre-selected doctor retained.
Prescription list shows last known state with 'Last updated [time]' label. Warning badge. Retry button. Never show stale data as current without warning.
Lab result card shows 'Results pending'. Estimated ready date shown. Push notification promised: 'We'll notify you when results are ready'.
Waiting room screen: 'Connection issue'. Auto-retry 3 times with countdown. If still failing: 'Switching to phone call' option offered. Appointment not marked as missed.

edge_cases.ui: Red warning banner on prescription detail: 'Potential interaction with [medication]'. Full interaction details. 'Contact your doctor' CTA prominent. Never hide this information.
Parent/guardian access controls visible. Sensitive information (mental health, reproductive health) requires explicit minor consent or is hidden from guardian view per regional law.
Warning before booking confirmation: 'This provider is out of network. Estimated cost: [amount]'. In-network alternatives shown. User must acknowledge before proceeding.
Push notification immediately. In-app: red urgent banner on result. Message: 'Please contact your doctor immediately'. Emergency contact shown. Never just show the value without context.
